title: How video games are made
examples: What is the difference between game design and coding?
Do you need to be an artist to make a video game?
What is a game engine and how does it help?

explain.say: Today we will say how video games are actually made.

items: Art: Creating the characters and worlds
Code: Writing the instructions for the game
Sound: Adding music and sound effects
Testing: Playing and fixing all the problems

explain.say: First, designers plan everything like a blueprint for a building.
Next, artists create all the pictures and models for the game world.
Coders write the instructions using programming languages to make things happen.
Sound designers add music and sound effects to make the game feel alive.
Finally, testers play the game repeatedly to find and fix any bugs.

faq.a: A game engine is like a big toolkit for making games. It provides many tools so you do not have to build everything from scratch.
asks: What is the purpose of a game engine?
Do I need to learn a game engine to code?
Is a game engine a type of code?

faq.q: Do I need to be good at art to make a game?
faq.a: No, you do not always need to be an artist. You can use pre-made art assets or work with an artist.
asks: Can I make a game with only code?
Is art skills mandatory for game developers?

faq.q: What is the difference between coding and scripting?
faq.a: Coding is writing the main program logic. Scripting is often used for smaller, specific actions within the game.
asks: Are coding and scripting the same thing?
Do I write scripts when I code?
What is the difference between the two terms?

faq.q: How do designers and coders work together?
faq.a: The designer creates the plan, and the coder builds the mechanics to match that plan. They must communicate clearly.
asks: Who tells the coder what to build?
Does the designer write the code?
What is the relationship between design and code?

faq.q: What is a bug in game development?
faq.a: A bug is simply an error in the code that makes the game behave incorrectly. Testing is all about finding these bugs.
asks: What does it mean to find a bug?
How do I fix a bug?

facts: Game engines provide pre-built tools for physics and rendering.
Game design focuses on the rules and player experience.
Coding brings the designed rules to life in the computer.
Testing is a crucial phase to ensure a smooth player experience.

quiz.say: If a game character suddenly falls through the floor, which stage likely needs fixing?
quiz.why: The movement and collision detection are programmed instructions, so the code needs adjustment.

wrong.1: Art is about the look, not the physical behavior.
wrong.2: Design sets the rule, but code makes the rule happen.
wrong.3: Sound is separate from the character's physical location.

quiz.say: What is the primary role of the game designer?
quiz.why: The designer is responsible for the overall concept and what the player should do.

wrong.1: That is the job of the sound designer.
wrong.2: Drawing is the job of the artist.
wrong.3: Debugging is the job of the tester or coder.

quiz.say: Which tool helps combine art, code, and sound?
quiz.why: A game engine is a large software package that contains many tools ready to use.

wrong.1: A blueprint is just a plan, not the working software.
wrong.2: A soundboard only handles audio, not visuals or code.
wrong.3: A style guide only dictates the look, not the function.
